headline: Ghana and Boeing Establish Roadmap for New National Airline
summary: Ghana's government and Boeing agreed on a strategic roadmap for establishing a new national carrier, addressing airline partners, licensing, fleet procurement, and financing.
why: National airline initiatives affect regional aviation infrastructure, trade corridors, and commercial aerospace manufacturers.

impacts.name: Boeing Co
impacts.why: Cooperation agreements on fleet development support potential future aircraft orders.
